# SangerTools - Tools for working with Population Health datasets

[![](reference/figures/sangertoolshex.png)](https://hutsons-hacks.info/)

## Background

Sanger Tools was born out of necessity.

It is the formal aggregation of a set of coding solutions employed
regularly to carry out Population Health Management Analytics; rapidly
and consistently. It has has been created specifically for
Gloucestershire CCG and wider National Health Service (NHS) staff
working with patient level population health data.

However, we hope Sanger Tools aids analytical workers around to world
who work with similar datasets.

Currently this will be best suited to CCG and CSU staff.

If you are using this package outside of the NHS we would be very keen
to hear from you!

The package draws its name from Sanger House; the office in which NHS
Gloucestershire CCG’s analytical team are based.

## Package Aims

The tools in this package have been created to assist in every-day tasks
undertaken by most NHS analysts. Functions have been created to provide
an easy-to-use interface for common tasks where analysts are working
between R, SQL and Excel. Many of the functions are created to work with
datasets which contain 1 Row Per Patient in tidy data format; where each
row is an observation and columns are variables pertaining to the
patient. This format is commonly seen across the NHS; often referred to
as Master Patient Index (MPI).

## API Notes

Many of the functions are written in Tidyverse; as such there will be
performance limitations on larger datasets. Please take care to read to
the documentation and included examples as the functions in this package
use a combination of Standard Evalutation (Base R) and [Non-Standard
Evalutation](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/articles/programming.html)
(Tidyverse).

## Installing the package from GitHub

You can install the package using the following commands

``` r

# install.packages("remotes") # if not already installed

remotes::install_github("ald0405/SangerTools")

library(SangerTools)
```

## Installing the package from CRAN

``` r

# install.packages("SangerTools")

library(SangerTools)
```

# Package index

## Analytics

Prevalence and standardised rate calculations.

- [`crude_rates()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/crude_rates.md)
  : Crude Prevalence Calculator
- [`standardised_rates_df()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/standardised_rates_df.md)
  : Standardised Prevalence Rates.

## Wrangling

Patient cohort wrangling helpers.

- [`age_bandizer()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/age_bandizer.md)
  : Age Band Creation: Create a new column of 5 year Age Bands from an
  integer column
- [`age_bandizer_2()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/age_bandizer_2.md)
  : Create age bands from a numerical column
- [`cohort_processing()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/cohort_processing.md)
  : Patient Cohort Re-Identification Processing
- [`split_and_save()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/split_and_save.md)
  : Split & Save

## Charts and theming

Branded ggplot2 chart helpers.

- [`categorical_col_chart()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/categorical_col_chart.md)
  : Plot Counts of Categorical Variables
- [`theme_sanger()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/theme_sanger.md)
  : Customised ggplot2 Theme
- [`scale_fill_sanger()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/scale_fill_sanger.md)
  : Branded discrete colour scale
- [`show_brand_palette()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/show_brand_palette.md)
  : Brand Colour Palette
- [`show_extended_palette()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/show_extended_palette.md)
  : Extended Brand Colour Palette

## I/O

Reading and writing data between R, Excel, CSV and SQL.

- [`df_to_sql()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/df_to_sql.md)
  : Dataframe to SQL
- [`excel_clip()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/excel_clip.md)
  : Dataframe or Tibble to Clipboard
- [`multiple_csv_reader()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/multiple_csv_reader.md)
  : Read Multiple CSV files into R
- [`multiple_excel_reader()`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/multiple_excel_reader.md)
  : Read Multiple Excel files into R

## Bundled datasets

Example population health datasets shipped with the package.

- [`PopHealthData`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/PopHealthData.md)
  : PopHealthData - Population health data for testing functions
- [`master_patient_index`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/master_patient_index.md)
  : Master Patient Index
- [`uk_pop_standard`](https://ald0405.github.io/SangerTools/reference/uk_pop_standard.md)
  : Data set of 2018 UK Population
